snippet.title: Pipeline for the BBC Micro
snippet.description:
Came also out for:



Game description:

Pipeline is an overhead arcade-puzzle adventure game in which you are on a mining platform set above Io, a sulphur-rich planet. Your task is to get all the sulphur while avoiding the hostile flame-like guardians.
